title: Ines and the Gravity
author: Wendell Montrose
blurb: Oscar Ishikawa, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent three years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then the colony's children start sharing the same dream — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
